## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why the change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests were added or updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, and relevant tests pass.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, generated local state, or debug artifacts are included.
- [ ] Visual changes were reviewed through the deterministic screenshot suite.
- [ ] Deployment or migration impact is documented.

## Security

Describe changes to trust boundaries, browser storage, network requests, dependencies, Cloudflare
bindings, or GitHub Actions. Write `None` when not applicable.
